verdict.rationale: Kong ships decK and kongctl as declarative, scriptable CLIs for APIOps/CI automation, plus DB-less/declarative deployment, Docker-based headless installs, and an Admin API for fully headless configuration and lifecycle management — all core to running Kong in CI/CD pipelines without a UI. missing for 10: no explicit CI pipeline example/tutorial (e.g. GitHub Actions) or independent third-party report confirming headless CI usage in production.
